body:
Design the empty state of the Accounts screen for **accounts**, a accounts application. Material 3 dark theme, 393×852dp (Pixel 5), Outfit font throughout.

Palette: background #101417, surface #101417, onSurface #E0E3E8, primary #95CDF7, onPrimary #00344E, primaryContainer #004B6F, secondary #B7C9D9, secondaryContainer #384956, surfaceVariant #41474D, onSurfaceVariant #C1C7CE, error #FFB4AB, outline #8B9198, outlineVariant #41474D.

**Component 1 - Stack** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): centered, generous vertical breathing room. Outfit Regular 14sp #E0E3E8.

**Component 2 - Stat Block** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): centered, generous vertical breathing room. Outfit Regular 14sp #E0E3E8.

**Component 3 - Chip Group** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): centered, generous vertical breathing room. Outfit Regular 14sp #E0E3E8.

**Component 4 - List** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): centered, generous vertical breathing room. Outfit Regular 14sp #E0E3E8.

**Component 5 - Banner** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): centered, generous vertical breathing room. Outfit Regular 14sp #E0E3E8.

**Component 6 - Empty State** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): Centered layout. Icon "sentiment_neutral" 48dp #C1C7CE. Title "Nothing here yet" Outfit Medium 20sp #E0E3E8. empty_state empty_state archetype.

**Component 7 - Error State** (centered, generous vertical breathing room): Centered layout. Error icon 48dp #FFB4AB. Title "Something went wrong" Outfit Medium 20sp #E0E3E8. Retry button filled #95CDF7 Outfit Medium 14sp. error_state archetype.

DO NOT use em-dash anywhere in text. DO NOT make any headline >3 lines or any subtitle >25 words. DO NOT break the page theme between sections. DO NOT place light text on light buttons or dark text on dark buttons.

The #95CDF7 primary accent threads through interactive elements with velvety clarity against the #101417 surface — calibrated to the minimalist-ui aesthetic.
